info.title: Aegis Notification Engine
info.description: Single source of truth for all outbound notifications across the Aegis ecosystem — email, in-app, push, SMS, webhook. Other engines only publish events; this engine decides whether/how/when to notify. This is the CANONICAL, checked-in contract — verified during the 2026-07 contract-first migration audit against real route implementations. See docs/CONTRACT_AUDIT.md.

engineApiKey.name: X-Engine-API-Key
engineApiKey.description: Bilateral shared secret, one per calling engine, checked against process.env.NOTIFICATION_ENGINE_API_KEY.

get.summary: Prometheus-format metrics (uptime + notification counts by status/channel)
get.description: No auth — matches the platform-wide no-auth-metrics convention. Coarse aggregate counts only, no per-user content.

post.summary: Ingest an event from another engine (service-to-service, fans out to enabled channels)
post.description: Body: eventId, eventType (one of EVENT_TYPES), recipientAegisId, payload, scheduledFor?. Never called directly by end users.

get.summary: Get the caller's unread notification count

post.summary: Mark one of the caller's own notifications read
post.description: Ownership-checked: 403 NOTIFICATION_FORBIDDEN if the notification's recipientAegisId doesn't match the caller.

post.summary: Mark all of the caller's own notifications read
